description: This file is a Java interface that defines database operations for the PatientService component in the OpenMRS healthcare platform. It declares methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting patient records, as well as managing related entities like allergies and identifiers.

classes.name: PatientDAO
classes.description: Interface for database operations related to Patient entities within the OpenMRS platform.

methods.name: savePatient
methods.description: Saves a Patient object to the database, returning the saved patient.

methods.name: getPatient
methods.description: Retrieves a Patient by its unique identifier.

methods.name: deletePatient
methods.description: Deletes a patient record from the database; intended for testing and administration.

methods.name: getAllPatients
methods.description: Retrieves all patients, optionally including voided records.

methods.name: getPatients
methods.description: Searches for patients based on query parameters, with support for paging and name-based search.

methods.name: getPatientIdentifiers
methods.description: Fetches patient identifiers based on various search criteria.

methods.name: savePatientIdentifierType
methods.description: Creates or updates a PatientIdentifierType.

methods.name: getAllPatientIdentifierTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all patient identifier types, including or excluding retired ones.

methods.name: getPatientIdentifierTypes
methods.description: Searches for patient identifier types based on name, format, and other attributes.

methods.name: getPatientIdentifierType
methods.description: Retrieves a PatientIdentifierType by its ID.

methods.name: deletePatientIdentifierType
methods.description: Deletes a specified PatientIdentifierType.

methods.name: getDuplicatePatientsByAttributes
methods.description: Finds duplicate patients based on a list of attributes.

methods.name: isIdentifierInUseByAnotherPatient
methods.description: Checks if a patient identifier is associated with another patient.

methods.name: getPatientByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Patient using its UUID.

methods.name: getPatientIdentifierByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a PatientIdentifier using its UUID.

methods.name: getPatientIdentifierTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a PatientIdentifierType by UUID.

methods.name: getPatientIdentifier
methods.description: Fetches a PatientIdentifier by its ID.

methods.name: savePatientIdentifier
methods.description: Saves a PatientIdentifier to the database.

methods.name: deletePatientIdentifier
methods.description: Removes a PatientIdentifier from the database.

methods.name: getCountOfPatients
methods.description: Counts patients matching a query, with or without including voided patients.
